selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What do the three truths together lead all kinds of animals to declare?
questions.answer: They all point to the oneness of Allah and testify that only He is worthy of worship.

questions.question: What does the agreement of all animals and birds show?
questions.answer: It shows a shared witness to Allah’s existence and unity.

questions.question: What does the traveler’s reaction tell us about the strength of the evidence?
questions.answer: It was strong enough for him to understand it fully.

questions.question: What does it mean that their bodily features are like “words”?
questions.answer: Their well-made parts and abilities show meaningful signs of Allah’s power and wisdom.

questions.question: What does “bringing into being” tell us about living things?
questions.answer: That their existence comes from a Creator.

questions.question: What truth about creation is connected to Allah’s will in the passage?
questions.answer: Bringing creatures into existence and making them is tied to His will.

questions.question: How does the passage use cause and effect?
questions.answer: It shows that careful creation, meaningful beauty, and wise design lead us to recognize one Creator.

questions.question: From what simple beginnings do these many living forms come?
questions.answer: They come from eggs and drops of sperm that are alike or very similar.

questions.question: What idea is repeated by describing beginnings as alike and outcomes as different?
questions.answer: That amazing diversity comes from simple similar sources by Allah’s will.

questions.question: What is the main message of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The animal world points together to Allah’s necessary existence and His oneness.

questions.question: What are they testifying to?
questions.answer: They are testifying to Allah’s existence and His being one.

questions.question: Besides birds, what other living creatures are included in this shared witness?
questions.answer: All species of animals are included.

questions.question: What does this image teach about the natural world?
questions.answer: It teaches that creation as a whole points to Allah in a unified way.

questions.question: What does the passage teach by linking creation with will?
questions.answer: That living things are not made randomly but by deliberate choice.

questions.question: What part of the passage points to Allah’s will?
questions.answer: The part about bringing creatures into existence and creating them.

questions.question: Why is it important that eggs and sperm are described as similar to one another?
questions.answer: It shows that very different creatures come from simple and closely alike starting points.

questions.question: How are the forms of animals described?
questions.answer: They are arranged, different, varied, and too many to fully count.

questions.question: What kind of reasoning is the passage using when it moves from similar beginnings to diverse creatures?
questions.answer: It is using evidence from creation to infer a wise and powerful Creator.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention both similarity and difference?
questions.answer: It highlights the contrast between simple beginnings and diverse results.

questions.question: According to the passage, what do all animal species do together?
questions.answer: They join in bearing witness to the truth that Allah is one.

questions.question: How broad is this testimony according to the passage?
questions.answer: It includes the whole earth through all species of animals and birds.

questions.question: What did the traveler understand when he saw this?
questions.answer: He grasped the meaning of the animal world’s testimony with certainty.

questions.question: What is special about the way animals and birds praise Allah here?
questions.answer: Their very creation and abilities act like praise and witness.

questions.question: What three big ideas are connected with how animals are made?
questions.answer: Bringing into being, distinguishing and beautifying, and measuring and shaping.
